title.en: Frontier premiums depend on measured task advantage.
title.zh: 前沿溢价取决于可测的任务优势。

thesis.en: A premium model can justify higher cost on tasks where its completion quality or review savings is material.
thesis.zh: 高价模型只有在任务完成质量或人工复核节省具有实质优势时，才可能合理化其更高成本。

falsifier.en: Paired production tests show no meaningful advantage after retries, review and tools.
falsifier.zh: 计入重试、复核与工具后，配对生产测试不再显示实质优势。

title.en: Multiple China-origin families challenge different constraints.
title.zh: 不同中国模型家族，正在改变不同约束。

thesis.en: Capability, task economics and deployability form different comparison surfaces; no single score represents the entire ecosystem.
thesis.zh: 能力、任务经济性与部署条件构成不同的比较面，不能以一个分数代替整个生态。

falsifier.en: Task-matched evaluations show the proposed specialization is not reproducible.
falsifier.zh: 按任务匹配的评测无法复现所提出的专长。

title.en: US competition extends beyond model weights.
title.zh: 美国模型竞争延伸到权重之外。

thesis.en: Tooling, access, distribution, serving economics and compute arrangements may influence which products are adopted.
thesis.zh: 工具、访问方式、分发、服务成本与算力安排，可能影响产品采用。

falsifier.en: Adoption data explains changes entirely without those product or distribution differences.
falsifier.zh: 采用数据能够在不考虑这些产品或分发差异的情况下完整解释变化。

title.en: Efficiency does not mechanically determine aggregate compute demand.
title.zh: 效率不会机械地决定总算力需求。

thesis.en: Compute demand depends jointly on workload volume, tokens per workload and serving efficiency.
thesis.zh: 算力需求共同取决于工作量、每项工作 token 数与服务效率。

falsifier.en: Observed demand, token intensity and efficiency jointly imply a different sign from the proposed scenario.
falsifier.zh: 观察到的需求、token 强度与效率共同给出了与所设情景相反的方向。

title.en: More compute architectures do not imply a single hardware winner.
title.zh: 更多算力架构，并不指向唯一硬件赢家。

thesis.en: Disclosed use of multiple platforms and custom-chip work suggests examining substitution and expansion separately.
thesis.zh: 多平台使用披露及定制芯片合作，提示应把替代效应与总量扩张分开考察。

falsifier.en: Delivered workloads remain concentrated despite planned diversification, or the planned systems do not ship.
falsifier.zh: 尽管计划多元化，实际工作负载仍高度集中，或计划中的系统没有交付。

title.en: Memory exposure needs both architecture and economic evidence.
title.zh: 存储敞口需要架构与经济数据共同验证。

thesis.en: Supply agreements identify exposure; they do not establish contract value, sustainable pricing or margins.
thesis.zh: 供应协议确认业务联系，但不能据此确定合同价值、持续定价能力或利润率。

falsifier.en: Supply growth, pricing pressure or design changes offset volume gains.
falsifier.zh: 供给增加、价格压力或设计变化抵消了数量增长。

title.en: Distribution advantages must reach paid use or measurable efficiency.
title.zh: 分发优势必须转化为付费使用或可测效率。

thesis.en: Device and cloud channels are routes to users; model popularity alone is not issuer profit.
thesis.zh: 设备与云渠道是触达用户的路径；模型热度本身不是公司利润。

falsifier.en: Adoption rises but attributable economics remain immaterial or negative.
falsifier.zh: 采用率上升，但可归属的经济收益仍不显著或为负。

title.en: Benchmark leadership and equity returns are separate questions.
title.zh: 基准领先与股票回报，是两个问题。

thesis.en: An instrument needs its own price, valuation denominator, business mix and risk analysis.
thesis.zh: 证券需要独立的价格、估值分母、业务组合及风险分析。

falsifier.en: No automatic benchmark-to-price mapping is permitted; this is a guardrail, not a return forecast.
falsifier.zh: 不允许自动从基准映射股价；这是分析约束，而非收益预测。
